subject: Pilot kickoff: access & staging ops (prompt review, routing, load tests)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Pilot kickoff: access & staging ops (prompt review, routing, load tests)

Hi Sanjay —

Following our discovery, we'd like to lock in a short pilot kickoff + hands-on session to validate prompts, routing and run a small routing/load test against your staging endpoint. Proposed agenda (60–90m):
- Quick intros & success criteria (10m)
- Environment checklist and API key verification (10m)
- Prompt walkthrough and examples (15–20m)
- Routing behavior & KV/cache brief (10m)
- Load test dry run (20–30m)

Proposed times:
- Thu Jul 22, 10:00–11:30 PT OR
- Fri Jul 23, 09:00–10:30 PT (we can be flexible)

Pre-kickoff items we need from you to avoid last-minute blockers:
1) Sandbox account prefixes / usernames for attendees (we'll need at least one sandbox user to verify tokens)
2) VPC allowlist entries (CIDR blocks) for our staging NAT IPs — see the checklist attachment for the IP ranges we use
3) Staging endpoint URL and any basic auth headers (if applicable)
4) If you want us to run load tests, give a target RPS/TPS and an expected sequence length for prompts

I'm attaching a quick kickoff checklist and a draft load-test plan to speed things up. Also created a shared doc for prompt review: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2B3cK-prompt-review-example — feel free to add examples there.

If Jul 22/23 don't work, send a couple slots and we'll update the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Rachel Kim
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com)
Attachments: 2026-07-18_kickoff-checklist.pdf (PDF), 2026-07-18_loadtest-plan.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks Rachel — this is helpful. A few quick items from our side: 
- Sandbox accounts: prefix is "quantify-sb-"; I'll send the list of usernames by EOD Monday.
- VPC allowlist: NetOps manages our perimeter. They asked for the exact source IPs you expect. Can you confirm the outbound IPs for Redwood staging? (we saw the ranges in the checklist but NetOps needs a single CIDR to put in their ticket)
- API keys: we can provide a temporary API key scoped to the sandbox project; otherwise we can create a service account for you. Temporary key would be fastest.
- Staging endpoint: https://staging.quantify.ai/api/v1/infer — uses an internal API key header X-Api-Key

Also, Fri Jul 23 works better for our engineering leads. Can we aim for Jul 23 09:30 PT? If not, the morning window on Jul 24 is open as well.

I'll loop in NetOps (netops@quantify.ai) for allowlisting. Lisa will coordinate the sandbox user list.

—
Sanjay Rao
Head of Product, QuantifyAI
(sanjay@quantify.ai)

For convenience, put the following CIDR in the ticket (these are the public egress ranges from our staging fleet): 34.120.16.0/24, 34.120.17.0/24. If your NetOps wants an exact list, we can provide line items IP-by-IP.

API key: temporary sandbox key is perfect. If you can scope it to the "quantify-sandbox" project and set a 48h TTL that's ideal. Please avoid granting production scopes.

Ben — can you add the load runner details to the shared load test plan and confirm expected peak TPS and the warm-up cadence? Marissa — can you own the prompt doc and put 6 canonical prompts under the "routing" section prior to the session? Link again: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2B3cK-prompt-review-example

I'll send the updated invite once I have the final attendees list.

Rachel

Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: access & staging ops (prompt review, routing, load tests)

Rachel — I've updated the shared load test sheet and attached a short runner config in the drive. Key points:
- Target peak: 12 TPS sustained for 3 minutes (ramp 0->12 over 60s)
- Warm-up: two warmup runs at 2 TPS and 6 TPS, 90s each
- Batch size: 8 tokens per batch (we'll test 8/16 to see latency impact)
- Payload sizes: 128/256 tokens typical; use the canonical prompting set from Marissa
- Endpoint to hit (staging LB): https://staging-ingress.quantify.ai/v1/infer (TLS)
- Headers: X-Api-Key: <REDACTED_TEMP_KEY> — Sanjay, please confirm final header name and if there are any additional HMACs required

Attachment (drive): load-runner-config.yaml

I'll be on the call Jul 23 09:30 PT to run the tests and monitor.

—
Ben Carter
Performance Engineer | Redwood Inference
(ben.carter@redwoodinference.com)
Attachments: load-runner-config.yaml (YAML, Drive link)
